spec_match.rationale: Targets the exact css-color-5 alpha() grammar; when this browser reports CSS.supports false, the page runs the real rgb(from ... / calc(alpha*k)) relative-color path and labels it as the fallback rather than faking alpha() output.

interactive.rationale: Controls rebuild the rendered output and the aria-live declaration readout with real computed values.

edge_cases.rationale: Unsupported-alpha() handling is honest, but invalid-grammar and out-of-range k cases are not exercised.

conformance.rationale: Root suite honestly rendered 0 pass / 8 fail in this pre-alpha() browser — assertions can genuinely fail, matching the spec contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless-Chrome CDP run 2026-08-16 drove the controls and read live computed declarations; zero console errors, zero failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: No explicit assert observed for the supported/fallback branch on this page.

accessibility.rationale: aria-live declaration readout, labelled inputs, native controls; the deliberately-disabled exhibit button is explained by adjacent copy and aria-disabled.

openQuestions.title: Assert the supported/fallback branch via telemetry
openQuestions.detail: Add a showcaseTelemetry assert recording CSS.supports('color','rgb(from red r g b / alpha(0.5))')-style detection and which path rendered, so production telemetry distinguishes native alpha() rollout from the fallback.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric's accessibility and runtime_evidence scores applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's primary controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Mode buttons and the parameter slider rebuilt the live declaration (alpha(from var(--origin) / …) vs calc-scaled) with honest supports=false framing; zero console errors.
